scope: Isolated inferred PostgreSQL fixture; not production Supabase/Auth, live policies or concurrent independent sessions

checks.name: no unauthenticated access
owner checkout creates sale, lines, movement and audit atomically
same retry key returns original sale without a second stock deduction
request-key reuse with another body is rejected
insufficient stock rolls back every earlier cart line
tenant product ID cannot be used at checkout
tenant customer ID cannot be used at checkout
receipt namespaces accept retained paths and reject foreign or traversing objects
duplicate lines, fractional quantity, below-cost price and NaN are rejected
rep sells holdings, preserves dispatch debt and awaits approval
rep cannot adjust warehouse stock or cancel owner sale
manager adjustment compares current stock and keeps retry idempotent
warehouse cancellation restores stock once with an audit trail
journal reconciles all warehouse and rep balances
report excludes cancelled/pending sales and sums cost snapshots
bulk import is all-or-nothing with SKU uniqueness
metadata edits cannot overwrite a concurrent stock deduction
customer creation is tenant-derived, audited and idempotent
inactive and suspended business sessions are rejected
dispatch cannot oversell, exceed the request or accept another tenant product
receiving creates stock, invoice lines and audit in one transaction
receiving rejects invoice reuse with different details or a historical receipt
bad receiving cart rolls back earlier stock writes and receipt records
receiving rejects foreign supplier, foreign attachment and representative access
RLS hides other tenant movements and audit; reps only read their own movement
public signup cannot choose an existing tenant or staff/admin role
business signup always creates its own tenant and owner with default categories
only an active owner can reserve a least-privilege staff invitation
one staff email reservation cannot be raced or claimed by another business
browser roles cannot call service-only staff provisioning functions
a verified Auth invitation creates the approved profile and audit exactly once
an existing public account cannot be taken over through edited invite metadata
even a matching invitation cannot reassign an existing foreign-tenant profile
